content: VDR-standard access segregation model has 4 tiers: No Access / View-only / Download-Print / Full. Supporting controls: watermarking (dynamic, per-viewer), exportable audit trail/logs, 2FA, AES-256 at rest + TLS in transit, download/view tracking, expiry dates on granted access. This tiering is the practical 'need-to-know' mechanism pre-close.
